pairs.target: chūfā qiányìwǎn , tǎ wéi de bāofú yǒu liǎnggè jié , sè lā chāi le qízhōng yígè .
pairs.english: The evening before departure, Tavi's bundle had two knots; Sela undid one of them.
pairs.hanzi: 出发前一晚，塔维的包袱有两个结，瑟拉拆了其中一个。

pairs.target: " zhège liúgěi míngzǎo de bǐng . "
pairs.english: “Leave this for tomorrow morning's flatbread.”
pairs.hanzi: “这个留给明早的饼。”

pairs.target: tā biàn bǎ zuì shàngmiàn de yīfu wǎngxiàyā .
pairs.english: He pressed the clothes on top farther down.
pairs.hanzi: 他便把最上面的衣服往下压。

pairs.target: yīfu zhǐyǒu liǎng shēn , yā lái yā qù , bāofú yě méiyǒu xiǎo duōshǎo .
pairs.english: There were only two sets of clothes; however much he pressed, the bundle barely got smaller.
pairs.hanzi: 衣服只有两身，压来压去，包袱也没有小多少。

pairs.target: tā zǒng juéde hái gāi dài xiē shénme , kě zhuōshàng shèng de dōngxī , měi yíyàng dōu zài jiālǐ yǒuyòng .
pairs.english: He kept feeling he should take something else, but everything left on the table had a use at home.
pairs.hanzi: 他总觉得还该带些什么，可桌上剩的东西，每一样都在家里有用。

pairs.target: liùtiān qián , tā jiāng qiānhǎo de dáfù sòngdào gōngsuǒ .
pairs.english: Six days earlier, he had delivered the signed reply to the office.
pairs.hanzi: 六天前，他将签好的答复送到公所。

pairs.target: shōujiàn de rén shōuzǒu shìdú nà yì lián , zài liúxià de zhǐ shàng xiě le bào dào rì .
pairs.english: The receiving clerk took the trial agreement slip and wrote the reporting date on the paper he kept.
pairs.hanzi: 收件的人收走试读那一联，在留下的纸上写了报到日。

pairs.target: nài lěi kànguò rìqī , dìngxià yǔ tā tóngháng ,
pairs.english: Nerai checked the date and arranged to travel with him,
pairs.hanzi: 奈蕾看过日期，定下与他同行，

pairs.target: shuō yán shàngshān de jiù yìlù zǒu , yìtiān néng dào ;
pairs.english: saying the old relay road up the mountain would get them there in a day;
pairs.hanzi: 说沿上山的旧驿路走，一天能到；

pairs.target: lù qián shěng xiàlái , dàn xiédǐ dé xiān bǔ hǎo .
pairs.english: they could save the fare, but his soles needed mending first.
pairs.hanzi: 路钱省下来，但鞋底得先补好。

pairs.target: zhèxiē tiān tā zhàocháng shànggōng , zuìhòu yìbān jiéshù cái bǎ lǐngliào pái jiāohuí .
pairs.english: He worked as usual those days, only handing back his materials token when the last shift ended.
pairs.hanzi: 这些天他照常上工，最后一班结束才把领料牌交回。

pairs.target: guǎnshì jiào tā jiāng jiè de gōuzǐ guàhuí yuánchù ,
pairs.english: The foreman told him to hang the borrowed hook back in its place,
pairs.hanzi: 管事叫他将借的钩子挂回原处，

pairs.target: méiyǒu dāying gěi tā liú gōng , yě méiyǒu shuō cóngcǐ bùxǔ zài lái .
pairs.english: without promising to keep his job or saying he could never come back.
pairs.hanzi: 没有答应给他留工，也没有说从此不许再来。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi cā le gōu bǐng cái guàshàngqù , zǒu chūlú chǎng shí , shǒulǐ kōng dé bù xíguàn .
pairs.english: Tavi wiped the handle before hanging it up; as he left the furnace yard, his empty hands felt unfamiliar.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维擦了钩柄才挂上去，走出炉场时，手里空得不习惯。

pairs.target: rújīn nà zhī shǒu zài bāofú lǐ mō dào liànxí yòng de wān jiāzi .
pairs.english: Now that hand found the bent practice clip inside his bundle.
pairs.hanzi: 如今那只手在包袱里摸到练习用的弯夹子。

pairs.target: tā bǎ tā qǔchū , tóng jìlùzhǐ yìqǐ guǒhǎo , fàngdào zuì lǐmiàn .
pairs.english: He took it out, wrapped it with his record sheets, and placed it at the very bottom.
pairs.hanzi: 他把它取出，同记录纸一起裹好，放到最里面。

pairs.target: yuánxiān nàgēn yǒu yuè yáyìn de dànpiàn yě zài , biānyuán yòng bùbāo zhe , búhuì gē huài yīfu .
pairs.english: The original spring strip with the crescent marks was there too, its edges wrapped in cloth so they would not cut his clothes.
pairs.hanzi: 原先那根有月牙印的弹片也在，边缘用布包着，不会割坏衣服。

pairs.target: qiāomén shēngxiǎng shí , sè lā zhèngzài tiāo zhēn .
pairs.english: Sela was choosing needles when the knock came.
pairs.hanzi: 敲门声响时，瑟拉正在挑针。

pairs.target: ā duó dàilái yìxiǎo jié là , shuō shì sùchù huàndēng shèng de ,
pairs.english: Ado brought a short bit of wax left over from changing the light at his lodgings, he said;
pairs.hanzi: 阿铎带来一小截蜡，说是宿处换灯剩的，

pairs.target: guǒ bāofú de xiàntóu mǒ yìdiǎn , bù róngyì sàn .
pairs.english: rub a little on the binding thread ends, and they would not fray so easily.
pairs.hanzi: 裹包袱的线头抹一点，不容易散。

pairs.target: tā zuò dào ménkǎn biān , xiān jiào tǎ wéi táijiǎo , kànkàn bǔguò de xiédǐ .
pairs.english: He sat by the threshold, first asking Tavi to lift his foot so he could inspect the mended sole.
pairs.hanzi: 他坐到门槛边，先叫塔维抬脚，看看补过的鞋底。

pairs.target: " zhèhuí dǎo méi lòu . "
pairs.english: “No holes this time, at least.”
pairs.hanzi: “这回倒没漏。”

pairs.target: " nǐ wǎng lǐ cǎi yìjiǎo shìshì ? "
pairs.english: “Want to step inside and try it?”
pairs.hanzi: “你往里踩一脚试试？”

pairs.target: " wǒ háiyào zǒu huílái . "
pairs.english: “I still need to walk back.”
pairs.hanzi: “我还要走回来。”

pairs.target: ā duó xiào zhe tāochū nà zhāng gǎiguò de shōutiáo .
pairs.english: Ado laughed and took out the corrected receipt.
pairs.hanzi: 阿铎笑着掏出那张改过的收条。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi zǎo bǎ nài lěi de huí tiáo jiāogěi tā , tā yě qù le huòzhàn hé zhàng .
pairs.english: Tavi had already given him Nerai's reply slip, and he had gone to the freight station to review the accounts.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维早把奈蕾的回条交给他，他也去了货站核账。

pairs.target: hé dào zuìhòu , zhī bǎ yuánlái de kòukuǎn gǎichéng yóuní sǔnhào , jīné méi zài biàn .
pairs.english: In the end they only reclassified the original deduction as oily-sludge loss; the amount did not change again.
pairs.hanzi: 核到最后，只把原来的扣款改成油泥损耗，金额没再变。

pairs.target: " nà méi háishì méi huílái ? "
pairs.english: “Still didn't get that coin back?”
pairs.hanzi: “那枚还是没回来？”

pairs.target: " méiyǒu . fēn chūlái de zāngdōngxī quèshí nàme zhòng . "
pairs.english: “No. The dirt we separated really did weigh that much.”
pairs.hanzi: “没有。分出来的脏东西确实那么重。”

pairs.target: ā duó yòng zhǐtou tán le tán zhǐ , " zhìshǎo xiàhuí bùnéng ná zhè yídài shuō wǒ bǎ zhěngjiàn dāng fèijiàn mài . "
pairs.english: Ado flicked the paper. “At least next time they can't use this sack to say I sold whole parts as scrap.”
pairs.hanzi: 阿铎用指头弹了弹纸，“至少下回不能拿这一袋说我把整件当废件卖。”

pairs.target: tā bǎ shōutiáo chóngxīn zhé hǎo , shōuhuí zìjǐ yījīn lǐ , méiyǒu sāi dào tǎ wéi de bāo zhōng .
pairs.english: He refolded the receipt and tucked it into his own jacket, without putting it into Tavi's bag.
pairs.hanzi: 他把收条重新折好，收回自己衣襟里，没有塞到塔维的包中。

pairs.target: sè lā dìgěi tā bǔ hǎo de wàiyī , jiào tā chuān shàng shēn yi shēn gēbo .
pairs.english: Sela handed him his mended coat and told him to put it on and stretch his arms.
pairs.hanzi: 瑟拉递给他补好的外衣，叫他穿上伸一伸胳膊。

pairs.target: zhǒubù de xīn bù bǐ jiù bù yìng , ā duó qǔ le liǎngxià shǒubì , shuō xiàng yǒurén zài hòumiàn lā tā .
pairs.english: The new cloth at the elbows was stiffer than the old; Ado bent his arms twice and said it felt like someone pulling him from behind.
pairs.hanzi: 肘部的新布比旧布硬，阿铎曲了两下手臂，说像有人在后面拉他。

pairs.target: " chuān liǎngtiān jiù ruǎn le . bié ná dāo guā . " tā shuō .
pairs.english: “It'll soften after two days' wear. Don't scrape it with a knife,” she said.
pairs.hanzi: “穿两天就软了。别拿刀刮。”她说。

pairs.target: tā wèn tǎ wéi , dào le nàbiān shénme shíhòu xiě dìyī fēngxìn .
pairs.english: He asked Tavi when he would write his first letter after getting there.
pairs.hanzi: 他问塔维，到了那边什么时候写第一封信。

pairs.target: " zhù xià jiù xiě . "
pairs.english: “I will write as soon as I settle in.”
pairs.hanzi: “住下就写。”

pairs.target: " xiān shuō fàn . bié yìzhāng zhǐ quán shì tiě . "
pairs.english: “Start with the food. Don't fill the whole page with iron.”
pairs.hanzi: “先说饭。别一张纸全是铁。”

pairs.target: sè lā zhèngzài zhǎo jiǎnxiàn de xiǎodāo , wényánxiào chū le shēng .
pairs.english: Sela, looking for the little knife to cut thread, laughed aloud at that.
pairs.hanzi: 瑟拉正在找剪线的小刀，闻言笑出了声。

pairs.target: ā duó qǐ shēnchuān hǎo yīfu , shuōmíng zǎo gǎnzǎo bān , bùnéng sòngdào lùkǒu .
pairs.english: Ado stood and settled his coat, saying he had an early shift tomorrow and could not see him off at the junction.
pairs.hanzi: 阿铎起身穿好衣服，说明早赶早班，不能送到路口。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi shuō zhīdào , xiǎng zàishuō yíjù , yòu bèi tā qiǎng le xiān .
pairs.english: Tavi said he knew and wanted to add something, but Ado spoke first.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维说知道，想再说一句，又被他抢了先。

pairs.target: " shuǐ de shì wǒ jì zhe . nǐ bié jīnwǎn gēn wǒ dàobié sānhuí . "
pairs.english: “I remember about the water. Don't say goodbye to me three times tonight.”
pairs.hanzi: “水的事我记着。你别今晚跟我道别三回。”

pairs.target: tā zǒu hòu , ménkǒu liáng xiàlái .
pairs.english: After he left, the doorway grew cold.
pairs.hanzi: 他走后，门口凉下来。

pairs.target: sè lā yòng jiǎo bǎmén tuī lǒng , zhuōshàng de xiàntuán gǔn dào tǎ wéi shǒubiān .
pairs.english: Sela nudged the door shut with her foot; the ball of thread on the table rolled toward Tavi's hand.
pairs.hanzi: 瑟拉用脚把门推拢，桌上的线团滚到塔维手边。

pairs.target: " wàziná lái . "
pairs.english: “Bring the sock.”
pairs.hanzi: “袜子拿来。”

pairs.target: nà zhī cóng xiāng fènglǐ zhǎochū de wàzi xǐ guò , dòng hái zài .
pairs.english: The sock found in the chest's gap had been washed, but the hole remained.
pairs.hanzi: 那只从箱缝里找出的袜子洗过，洞还在。

pairs.target: tā bǎ zhēn chuān hǎo , jiào tā xiān yán pòkǒu wàimiàn zǒu yìquān ,
pairs.english: She threaded the needle and taught him to stitch once around the outside of the hole first,
pairs.hanzi: 她把针穿好，教他先沿破口外面走一圈，

pairs.target: liúzhù méi sàn de xiàn , zài yìlái yìhuí dì bǔ .
pairs.english: holding the unfrayed threads in place before darning back and forth.
pairs.hanzi: 留住没散的线，再一来一回地补。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi dìyī zhēn jiù zhā dào shǒuzhǐ , tòng dé suō le yíxià .
pairs.english: Tavi pricked his finger on the first stitch and flinched with pain.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维第一针就扎到手指，痛得缩了一下。

pairs.target: " búshì nǐng luómào , bié shǐ nàme dà jìn . "
pairs.english: “You're not tightening a nut. Don't use so much force.”
pairs.hanzi: “不是拧螺帽，别使那么大劲。”

pairs.target: tā jiāng wàzi fānláifùqù , nòngbùqīng xiàn dào le nǎ yímiàn .
pairs.english: He turned the sock over and over, unable to tell which side the thread had reached.
pairs.hanzi: 他将袜子翻来覆去，弄不清线到了哪一面。

pairs.target: sè lā bǎ zìjǐ de shǒu fàngzài zhuōshàng , méiyǒu jiēguò qù ,
pairs.english: Sela rested her own hands on the table instead of taking it over,
pairs.hanzi: 瑟拉把自己的手放在桌上，没有接过去，

pairs.target: zhī ràng tā jiāng shǒuzhǐ shēnjìn wàzi , dǐngzhù pòkǒu .
pairs.english: only telling him to put his fingers inside the sock to support the hole.
pairs.hanzi: 只让他将手指伸进袜子，顶住破口。

pairs.target: dēng xià , tā fèng chū yíkuài wāiwāi de wǎng .
pairs.english: Under the lamp, he stitched a crooked mesh.
pairs.hanzi: 灯下，他缝出一块歪歪的网。

pairs.target: zhēn zài chuān huílái , wǎngyǎn shōu xiǎo le yìdiǎn .
pairs.english: The needle passed back through, and the gaps in the mesh grew a little smaller.
pairs.hanzi: 针再穿回来，网眼收小了一点。

pairs.target: tā zuò dé màn , sè lā biàn chèn zhè gōngfū bǎ míngzǎo de bǐng hōng hǎo , yòng gānbù gàizhù .
pairs.english: He worked slowly, so Sela used the time to toast tomorrow morning's flatbread and cover it with a dry cloth.
pairs.hanzi: 他做得慢，瑟拉便趁这工夫把明早的饼烘好，用干布盖住。

pairs.target: děng tā huílái , dòng yǐjīng búshì dòng , zhǐshì yíkuài hěn nánkàn de hòu gēda .
pairs.english: When she returned, the hole was no longer a hole, just an ugly, thick lump.
pairs.hanzi: 等她回来，洞已经不是洞，只是一块很难看的厚疙瘩。

pairs.target: " huì mó jiǎo . " tǎ wéi shuō .
pairs.english: “It'll rub my foot,” Tavi said.
pairs.hanzi: “会磨脚。”塔维说。

pairs.target: " xiān shì . "
pairs.english: “Try it first.”
pairs.hanzi: “先试。”

pairs.target: tā tuōxié chuān shàng , zhàn qǐlái zǒu le jǐbù . guǒrán mó .
pairs.english: He took off his shoe, put the sock on, and stood to walk a few steps. It did rub.
pairs.hanzi: 他脱鞋穿上，站起来走了几步。果然磨。

pairs.target: tā yǐwéi tā yào xiào , sè lā què ràng tā bǎ zuì jǐn de liǎng zhēn chāidiào , tān píng zài fèng .
pairs.english: He thought she would laugh, but Sela had him undo the two tightest stitches, flatten it, and sew again.
pairs.hanzi: 他以为她要笑，瑟拉却让他把最紧的两针拆掉，摊平再缝。

pairs.target: bāofú chǎng zài jiǎo biān , tā dūnxià shí tī dào tā , lǐmiàn de zhǐ qīngqīng xiǎng le yìshēng .
pairs.english: The bundle lay open by his feet; as he crouched he knocked it, and the papers inside rustled softly.
pairs.hanzi: 包袱敞在脚边，他蹲下时踢到它，里面的纸轻轻响了一声。

pairs.target: zhè yícì , bǔ hǎo de dìfāng méi nàme gè le .
pairs.english: This time the darned patch was less uncomfortable.
pairs.hanzi: 这一次，补好的地方没那么硌了。

pairs.target: sè lā gěi tā yìzhī jiù zhēntǒng , lǐmiàn liú yìgēn zhēn , wàitou chán liǎngzhǒng yánsè de xiàn .
pairs.english: Sela gave him an old needle case with one needle inside and thread in two colors wound around the outside.
pairs.hanzi: 瑟拉给他一只旧针筒，里面留一根针，外头缠两种颜色的线。

pairs.target: tā zìjǐ chángyòng de nàgēn réng chā zài bù diàn shàng .
pairs.english: The needle she regularly used was still stuck in the cloth pad.
pairs.hanzi: 她自己常用的那根仍插在布垫上。

pairs.target: " bié hùnjìn yīfu duī . zhā le biérén , nǐ shuō bù zhīdào yě méiyòng . "
pairs.english: “Don't lose it among the clothes. If someone gets pricked, saying you didn't know won't help.”
pairs.hanzi: “别混进衣服堆。扎了别人，你说不知道也没用。”

pairs.target: tā jiāng zhēntǒng fàngjìn wài dài , mō le liǎngbiàn dàikǒu .
pairs.english: He put the needle case in the outer pocket and felt the opening twice.
pairs.hanzi: 他将针筒放进外袋，摸了两遍袋口。

pairs.target: wūlǐ jiànjiàn zhī shèng zàohuǒ de shēngxiǎng .
pairs.english: Gradually only the stove fire could be heard in the room.
pairs.hanzi: 屋里渐渐只剩灶火的声响。

pairs.target: sè lā qù shōu shuǐguàn , tā gēnzhe zhàn qǐlái ,
pairs.english: Sela went to put away the water jars, and he stood after her;
pairs.hanzi: 瑟拉去收水罐，他跟着站起来，

pairs.target: tā kàn tā yìyǎn , bǎ xiǎo de nà zhī dìgěi tā .
pairs.english: she glanced at him and handed him the smaller one.
pairs.hanzi: 她看他一眼，把小的那只递给他。

pairs.target: liǎng rén jiāng míngzǎo yào yòng de shuǐfèn hǎo , dàguàn liúzài zào biān , búbì bān .
pairs.english: They portioned out the water for tomorrow morning, leaving the large jar by the stove with no need to move it.
pairs.hanzi: 两人将明早要用的水分好，大罐留在灶边，不必搬。

pairs.target: " wǒ pà dào le nàér , shénme dōu dé wèn . " tǎ wéi shuō .
pairs.english: “I'm afraid I'll have to ask about everything there,” Tavi said.
pairs.hanzi: “我怕到了那儿，什么都得问。”塔维说。

pairs.target: " jīntiān nǐ yě wèn le . "
pairs.english: “You asked today too.”
pairs.hanzi: “今天你也问了。”

pairs.target: tā dītóu kànkàn jiǎo shàng de wàzi .
pairs.english: He looked down at the socks on his feet.
pairs.hanzi: 他低头看看脚上的袜子。

pairs.target: sè lā cóng zhuōxià chōuhuí zìjǐ de dèngzǐ , zuòxià róu xīgài .
pairs.english: Sela pulled her stool from under the table and sat to rub her knees.
pairs.hanzi: 瑟拉从桌下抽回自己的凳子，坐下揉膝盖。

pairs.target: " yǒurén kěn jiào , nǐ jiù tīng . méi rén kěn jiào , xiān bié bǎ wàzi rēng le . "
pairs.english: “When someone is willing to teach, listen. When nobody is, don't throw the sock away just yet.”
pairs.hanzi: “有人肯教，你就听。没人肯教，先别把袜子扔了。”

pairs.target: tā xiào le yíxià , bǎ bāofú chóngxīn xì hǎo , bǐng de wèizhì liú zhe .
pairs.english: He smiled and tied the bundle again, leaving room for the flatbread.
pairs.hanzi: 他笑了一下，把包袱重新系好，饼的位置留着。

pairs.target: shuì qián , tǎ wéi shēnshǒu qù mō ménshuān , fāxiàn sè lā yǐjīng luò hǎo le .
pairs.english: Before bed, Tavi reached for the door bolt and found Sela had already slid it into place.
pairs.hanzi: 睡前，塔维伸手去摸门闩，发现瑟拉已经落好了。

pairs.target: tā zhàn zài ménbiān tīng le yíhuìer , wàitou háishì nàtiáo gōu de shuǐshēng ,
pairs.english: He stood by the door listening for a while; outside was the same sound of water in the ditch,
pairs.hanzi: 他站在门边听了一会儿，外头还是那条沟的水声，

pairs.target: gébì yǒurén xǐ pén , yuǎnchù huànbān de língxiǎng le dìèrbiàn .
pairs.english: someone next door washing a basin, the distant shift bell ringing a second time.
pairs.hanzi: 隔壁有人洗盆，远处换班的铃响了第二遍。

pairs.target: tā yǐqián xián nà líng zǒng bǎ rén jiàoxǐng .
pairs.english: He used to resent that bell always waking people.
pairs.hanzi: 他以前嫌那铃总把人叫醒。

pairs.target: jīnwǎn míngmíng hái méi shuì , què shèbùdé tā tíng .
pairs.english: Tonight, though he had not even gone to sleep, he did not want it to stop.
pairs.hanzi: 今晚明明还没睡，却舍不得它停。
